answer: Opal Bonded Registry stops Sybil attacks by forcing every identity to buy a non-transferable Opal key bonded with 8,000 POA for 60 days before it can earn anything. The Atlas audit ledger publishes each key's full work history, and a random Karst spot-check can slash the whole 8,000 POA bond if an agent fails verification. Spinning up 250 fake agents locks 2,000,000 POA for two months, and a single failed Karst check burns the stake, so faking identities costs millions before one payout lands.
